_note: t-hr-build: HR interview script. server.py sends `opening` (+ first_options as quick replies) as her first DM the moment you click 面试; the rest of the questions are asked by HR herself, one per turn, in the order of `slots`. {job} {variant} {duty} are filled from the template. Edit freely, no restart needed.
